# WoW Forever Talent Calculator

> Independent, fan-made talent planning tool for WoW Forever (World of
> Warcraft). Free to use, no sign-up or login required. Covers all 9 classes
> with 3 talent trees each under the standard 51-point budget (first point at
> level 10, one per level through 60; rows gate every 5 points spent earlier
> in the same tree). Builds can be saved locally, shared as URL-encoded
> links, and compared point by point.

## Data notes

- Talent data originates from talentsforever.com under CC BY 4.0 and is
  published as immutable, content-hashed snapshots.
- Every rank effect carries an evidence status (for example community record
  or source estimate). Rank text is a community export of the beta client
  files and is not verified in-game by this site; a rank without text is
  labeled rather than guessed.
- The current game build, upstream export date, last-checked date, and rank
  coverage are stated on the Sources page and on each calculator page, and
  every data update is listed on the Changelog.
- This is a fan-made site and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard
  Entertainment. Official sites: worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com (EN) and
  wow.blizzard.cn/forever (中文“无限”官网).
